1.0.3: Fixed an error `JSON schema is invalid` that occurred when the AiAgent used a tool with an empty parameters object.
1.0.4: Added validation for required fields in components.
1.1.0: Added MakeApiCall component for performing arbitrary authorized API calls to the Anthropic (Claude) API.
1.1.1: Added a missing output example to ListModels.
1.1.2: AIAgent: removed the unused icon.svg duplicate (the icon comes from component.json); added output examples.
1.1.4: MakeApiCall: Request Headers and Query Parameters set in the Designer are now sent. They were silently dropped: the key-value field stores its rows as a JSON object string, which the component did not parse.
1.2.0: SendPrompt, TransformTextToJSON, AIAgent: added `usage` (input/output/cache tokens), `stop_reason` and `model` to the output. AIAgent sums `usage` across all API calls of the tool-use loop.

TransformTextToJSON: fixed a `ReferenceError` on the required Output JSON Schema check; when the response is cut off by `max_tokens`, the component now outputs `stop_reason: max_tokens` instead of failing.

AIAgent: new `tool` output port. Whatever is connected to it becomes a tool the agent calls directly, with no `ToolStart`/`ToolOutput` around it; fields set to the `Model Defined Parameter` variable are filled by the model, other values are sent as configured. Components connected behind it run as further steps of the same tool. MCP servers can be connected to the port too.
AIAgent: all tool calls of a turn are answered (the agent handled only the first one, which made the Claude API reject the next request), and the tool-use loop stops after 20 turns.

AIAgent: new Max Tokens input. Without it the agent now requests 8192 tokens instead of 1024 (4096 for the Claude 3 models, their limit): models with extended thinking used the whole 1024 tokens to think and answered with an empty text. Longer answers cost more output tokens.
AIAgent: a `ToolOutput` that comes after its tool call has timed out is removed from the flow state with the next message of the agent, instead of staying there.
